title: A flow's result follows the user across steps - floating window off the last step
description: Leaving a flow's last step tears the result out of the DOM: audio playback stops, and returning shows an empty pane. Frame-wide, every flow. Fabio's spec: while a result exists and the user is NOT on the last step, it rides in a floating window top-right (video looping silently, image as a thumbnail, audio as the player); on the last step the floating window goes away and the result shows in its normal box. SECOND HALF, added 2026-09-12 and handed over from MPI-664: reusing a gallery card must open the flow with THAT CARD'S result already loaded, replaced only by Generate - so the result plays in the floating window while he reads and edits the lyrics that produced it. Both halves are one feature; brief.md carries his words.
